scene.speaker: diego
scene.bubble: Maya's family is moving today! Everyone is carrying boxes… and nobody can find the cat.

activities.title: Read the sentences and write the furniture words.

words.clue: A big comfortable chair for one person.
They hang next to the window. You close them at night.
You look at yourself in it.
It is soft and covers the floor.
You put your head on it when you sleep.
It gives light on your desk or next to your bed.

activities.title: Who is doing what? Match the person with the action.

pairs.right: is packing the plates in paper
is filming everything for the news
is hiding in an empty drawer

activities.title: Listen to the moving day report. Write a word or number in each gap.

data.voice_note: Voces: Diego (reportando en vivo) y Maya (organizando).
data.script: Diego: Live from moving day! The truck is waiting outside. … Diego: Maya's dad is carrying the blue sofa with Uncle Leo. Careful with the stairs! … Maya: Box number twelve — books. Box thirteen — more books! … Diego: Maya has already labelled thirty boxes. … Diego: Her mum is wrapping the big mirror in a soft blanket. … Diego: Wait — where is the cat? Everyone is looking for the cat! … Maya: Found her! She's sleeping inside the drawer of my desk. … Diego: A perfect end. Next stop: the new house with the red door!

activities.title: Exam task · Choose the correct form.

data.instructions: Choose the correct present continuous form.

items.sentence: She ___ the cups in soft paper right now.
What ___ you doing with that lamp?

data.text: Mime an action in slow motion (carrying a sofa, packing plates…). Your partner narrates like Diego: "You are carrying something very heavy… it's a sofa!" Three mimes each.

homework.prompt: Sit in your living room and write 5 sentences about what everyone is doing right now: My brother is watching TV…
